decision: Separate baseline training validation from privileged linked-path safety validation

governingRule.description: Training must remain least-privilege while full symlink attack-boundary assertions remain fail-closed

alternativesConsidered.option: Require Developer Mode or elevation for every Windows training run
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Adds an unrelated administrative prerequisite to ordinary course completion.

whyWinner: Ordinary learners can complete the course without administrative capability, while a named full-safety suite still requires and executes real file and directory symlink cases.
revisitTrigger: Revisit if the course teaches symbolic links directly or every supported Windows training environment guarantees unprivileged file and directory symlink creation.
